list: Official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Guides written for this entry in our own words.

roadmap.text: Chapters 1 to 5, in order. Every chapter and mission trophy pops here, plus the partner trophies that need both Jason and Lucia. Do not skip Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1: it may be the one missable step. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because there is no mission replay.
roadmap.title: Play the story

roadmap.text: Finish the character quest lines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) and 8 stranger strands. None of these need 100% completion, and all stay open after the story, so take them at your own pace.
roadmap.title: Side quests and strangers

roadmap.text: Work through the counted trophies: 250 stunts, 42 shooting range golds, 14 drone race locations, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles, 18 meditations, 3 card sets, 52 explored areas, 9 gangs. Turn on progress and collectible notifications in Settings so nothing is missed.
roadmap.title: Collectibles and activities

roadmap.text: After the credits, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and clear what is left: robberies, 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations, underwater finds, 70 of 80 challenges. A Long Road (100%) is the last big trophy; the platinum pops with it.
roadmap.title: Clean-up and the platinum

pressstart.name: Press-Start: Full Trophy/Achievement List for GTA 6

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no shortcut: it is the last trophy by definition, and the long road to it runs through A Long Road, the 100% completion gold. Plan on roughly 200 hours in total, most of it on the clean-up stage after the story.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1, and finish it. It cannot be missed: just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1. It pops once you start the first mission of Chapter 2. While you are still in Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth: that step may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude and it disappears after the chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play through Chapter 2 to the end. It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after the Welcome to Vice City mission. Both Jason and Lucia become playable in this chapter, which opens up the partner trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3. Robberies and side quest lines open up in this chapter, so start the character quests (Andy, Randy, Tyrone) and the jewelry jobs as they appear rather than leaving them all for later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4. The first two missions of Chapter 4 set up the chapter trophies that follow, and the bank vault robberies unlock in this chapter, so try the optional mission That's Where The Money Is when it shows up.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, gold. Finish the last mission of the story. Free roam carries on after the credits, so nothing else depends on how you play this mission. Make a manual save before it anyway: with no mission replay, a save is your only way back.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends, so there is nothing extra to do and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Finish the mission and the trophy follows; no extra objective is needed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It unlocks when the mission is done.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Just play the mission through to its end.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. The same airport is where the Catch Me If You Can trophy is earned in free roam, so remember the layout for later.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story mission trophy, earned by finishing the mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy. After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion: everything you did before already counts, and nothing on the list is missable. It asks for all robberies (including 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every shooting range gold, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks, plus a share of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Work through the checklist in the game, not from memory.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to add to the total, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Check Progress, Activities, Stunts for your count, and use the map's Stunt Spot markers. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress, Activities shows what is left. Most of them happen naturally while you play; golf and pool are the ones to seek out on purpose.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Take your time and learn each range's target pattern; ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger. This is one of the few trophies the 100% checklist needs in full, so there is no way around it.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough here, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so it is worth finishing every race at a location while you are there instead of coming back.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from. Winning the same race again does not count, so vary the events. Car races, race challenges and drone races all count toward the activity types for Master of None too.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests, then beat him in his challenge. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind) are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick the game you find easiest and play it to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The last one awards the trophy. They stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list. None of them are needed for 100%, and all stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good places to look. Cars in better condition pay more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job (Shut Down the Labs) awards the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. WARNING: this is the one trophy that may be missable. In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do not skip it.
trophies.missableNote: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after the chapter. Do it the morning after Down to Earth.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so work through them all.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is. Cards are found around Leonida, so pick up every set you can while exploring for other trophies.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel and the total builds up on its own; the 100% checklist wants 100 as well, so this and the checklist line up.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress, Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way. If you are short, open the Challenges menu and pick the easiest unfinished ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway while working toward that.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge (planes parked out on the airfield do not count). Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks are at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way in, so go in with armor and a plan to get out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City works well.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts for this one too, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before vaults open up, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch. Do this while you travel for other trophies and the map fills in on its own; a dedicated flyover at the end finishes the last corners.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress, Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so keep robbing them after this trophy pops. Operations stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. The exact bar or interaction is not confirmed yet at launch: walk the Ocean Beach front, look for a bar or cocktail spot with a view, and order a drink there. This guide will be updated as players confirm the spot.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, a nod to the classic GTA opening. The exact showroom and steps are not confirmed yet at launch: try driving a car through a showroom's front glass in Vice City. This guide will be updated as players confirm it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason and Lucia, Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map, Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI to watch the count. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet at launch: it most likely pops when you pass something you failed once before, so if you fail an activity or challenge, try it again right away. This guide will be updated as players confirm it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet at launch: explore the odd corners of the map and watch for something out of the ordinary. This guide will be updated as players confirm it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle (a melee drive-by). The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch: drive slowly past pedestrians and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle. This guide will be updated as players confirm it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest. It counts all spending, so it builds up naturally; if you are short at the end, buy weapon mods or car upgrades.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. You need the garage space for the Scooter Bros registrations too, so buy them before finishing On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
